description: BC API v2.0 $metadata against the pinned document the BC ontology is generated from (ontology/generator/bc.py) and the compiled schema: every bound entity set (curated and generated) served with the key and every field its bindings read, each with the pin's Core.Computed flag (what the BC twin refuses to write), no capture-scope set served but unbound, no set declared not_served (postedSalesInvoices, salesReceivablesSetup, the custom-API plxCustomerShipTos) now served, no generated set gaining a decimal column the money overrides do not declare (regeneration would bind it as a plain decimal, never money), and whether api/v2.0 $metadata names a custom plx* API page. One GET /api/v2.0/$metadata through the GET-only client; entity-set and field names, digests and counts only, never a record. The pin is the live document published at 2026-10-13T11:01:25Z (sha256 09a82605, evidence_mode live-capture, re-pinned in a reviewed commit, never by a run): the run writes the document (--out {tmp}/metadata.xml), the runner validates it as a schema-only CSDL artifact (bc_metadata_csdl: no record) and publishes it, pass or fail, to results/artifacts/schema.bc_metadata_drift/<sha256>.xml when its digest changes; python3 -m ontology.generator.bc pin FILE re-pins from that file. Live-unverified until this check passes on reviewed main.
notes: live-unverified. bound_entity_sets names every BC entity set an ontology binding reads, so the source registry's evaluated stage derives for them from a pass (scripts/source_registry.py LiveIndex; source business-central). A failure is a schema finding, not a flake: missing_* names what BC no longer serves; stale/now_served mean regenerate (python3 -m scripts.gen_ontology_skeleton generate after re-pinning). metadata_changed is informational (any change to the document, bound or not). computed_changed names a bound field whose Core.Computed flag differs from the pin (BC's live document declared none on 2026-10-13): re-pin knowingly. A property BC does not serve is declared availability not_served (purchaseInvoices.remainingAmount): it is read by no binding and reported now_served when BC serves it. custom_api_pages_in_metadata lists registry API pages api/v2.0 $metadata names (expected none: custom AL API pages live under api/<publisher>/<group>/<version>). Output contract injected-transport tested (tests/test_gen_bc.py). A MetadataError (the document is outside the CSDL shape the generator parses) prints its fixed class as error_code (ontology/generator/bc.py MetadataError.code), which the runner publishes; the message is withheld. Every hourly run from 2026-10-08 02:51Z to 11:31Z failed MetadataError with a 35-character message and no class: the next run names it. undeclared_decimal_columns names a new Edm.Decimal/Double/Single column of a generated set that ontology/schema/overrides/money.json source_columns.bc does not declare: declare it (money) or re-pin knowingly (not money).
